Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
V:TES players:

The Bloodlines expansion, scheduled for release on December 03, 2001, contains 196 all-new cards (no reprints). That number includes 63 commons, 63 uncommons, and 70 rares. It also includes the promo card, The Baron (a Samedi vampire card) that is also included in the booster pack assortment (it is not a promo-only card).

A checklist with rarities (not a full-text spoiler list) will be posted on the web site on the day of the release.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
